explanation: Both endpoint values are 0, so the required equation is ∇f(c)·⟨1,1,−1⟩=2x+3z²=0. On the segment x=−z and y=1−z, giving z(3z−2)=0. Thus the points satisfying the equation on the stated closed segment are (−2/3,1/3,2/3) and (0,1,0), option b. The first is the interior point guaranteed by the theorem.
